_comment: Provider descriptor for Outlook / Hotmail / Microsoft 365 mail (providerID 'msgraph'), read by MailProviderCatalog. Outlook on the web has no per-conversation URL, so there is no webThreadURLTemplate: each message carries Graph's own webLink instead, and the reader opens that link only when its host is listed here. The sign-in registration lives with the service, in microservices/mail-graph/client.json.
